items.headline: PostgreSQL 19 adds read‑your‑writes consistency via WAIT FOR LSN
items.summary: The new PostgreSQL 19 release introduces a WAIT FOR LSN command that lets standby sessions ensure they have replayed recent writes before querying.
items.why_it_matters: Improves data consistency for applications using read replicas.
items.evidence_quote: PostgreSQL 19 adds "read-your-writes" consistency with the new WAIT FOR LSN command
